scope: Coupon/product multiset DML fence, explicit bounded maintenance runner, independent PostgreSQL and actual nonowner permission verification. Not a completed checkout read/write contract.

reports.failure: New parent-creation test issued BEGIN on a max:4 pool; postgres-js rejected UNSAFE_TRANSACTION. Fixed by running identical SQL using the existing stable max:1 peer. No weakened assertion or helper safety change.

testScope.independentBackends: financePeers validates four distinct stable backend PIDs; waiting cases use exact pg_blocking_pids, not elapsed-time guesses. Full ORM uses a random owned database and an actual nonowner LOGIN.
baselineGaps: Without the migration a parent SHARE lock does not prevent direct SQL relation INSERT.
Even with DML triggers a parent SHARE lock alone does not prevent TRUNCATE.
covered: duplicate insert and single duplicate deletion
nonpositive product IDs and existing nonpositive parent IDs
old and new parents on transfer
batch exchange and ascending parent lock order
equal count/sum but different pair multiset
exact net-zero/no-op/zero-row and unrelated-parent nonblocking controls
commit and rollback with a subsequent fresh reader statement
same-transaction parent creation/relation replacement and pre-owned parent lock
late installation failure rolls back partially created objects
actual template UPDATE privilege required by SECURITY INVOKER parent lock
low-privilege DML lock wait and dangerous DDL denial
full ORM and full external migration-directory construction

maintenance.requirement: Authorized explicit upgrade on existing database; do not replay the full historical MigrationService.runAll merely to install this fence.

localPostgres.cleanup: Only fixture-owned random databases/schemas/roles were removed by their helpers. Verified the exact dedicated server PID before stopping it. Binaries, data directory and original reports retained.

skills.influence: Short transactions, deterministic parent locking, transition-table semantics, rollback and actual nonowner verification; no new external transaction I/O.
skills.latestWorkersTypesRetrieval: npm view failed EACCES; used installed 5.20260828.1 Hyperdrive definitions. No bindings changed.

limitations: The existing template guard still evaluates the original relation snapshot; parent locking without fresh relation reading is insufficient.
Reader must hold the relation lock, validate the installed protocol and isolation/role/RLS contract, acquire parent SHARE, then issue a fresh set SELECT. No automatic checkout migration.
TRUNCATE requires an ordinary relation lock at read time; these INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE triggers do not cover it.
Administrative table/function/role/replica changes can bypass this protocol; local nonowner examples are not a production permissions gate.
Not a bidirectional foreign key: deleting a parent after a completed relation write is not prohibited by this fence.
Exact per-statement ordering does not eliminate all multi-statement or other-business deadlocks.
MigrationService registration, actual business handler integration, product/category/brand references, policy decisions, immutable CI and release remain open.
Tests are separate terminal runs and must not be summed with overlapping earlier reports. Historical PHP row reconciliation remains N/A per owner.
